crossExchangeFindings: A field called turnover rate is not an exchange-neutral semantic object.
TPEx published turnover statistics explicitly use issued shares.
TWSE documentation elsewhere distinguishes issued from listed shares; daily research must carry denominatorType explicitly.
Cross-exchange normalization is prohibited until the exact selected denominator space is proven for both exchanges.

securityTypeGuards.finding: Payment certificates began trading before the later registered-capital change. Registered-issued and exchange-listed/tradable clocks are not interchangeable.
Announcement wording around public-listed common shares and cumulative listed total does not yet prove one exact tradable-share denominator.

antiInference: This receipt does not claim every historical date has been captured.
This receipt does not convert TWSE 張-based labels into shares without official unit proof.
This receipt does not choose registered-issued versus exchange-listed/tradable as one universal denominator.
No signal, ranking, threshold, capital, monitor, push or execution logic is changed.
conclusion: CA-106 source-contract work is complete as a positive-and-negative evidence receipt: daily official denominator lanes are identified on both exchanges, but full archive readiness remains NO_GO until TWSE unit normalization, TPEx long-run ingestion, revision coverage and payment-certificate/private-placement semantics are resolved.
